{"code":"local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
    local atk = attacker.atk
    local level = attacker.level
    local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
    local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
    local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
    local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0

    local hp = defender.hp
    local shield = defender.shield or 0
    local armor = defender.armor
    local dlevel = defender.level
    local delement = defender.element
    local resist = defender.resist or {}
    local guarding = defender.guarding or false

    local power = skill.power
    local selement = skill.element or 'physical'
    local hits = skill.hits or 1
    local true_damage = skill.true_damage or false
    local seed = skill.seed or 0

    local emult = {
        physical = {fire=100, water=100, nature=100, neutral=100, ghost=0},
        fire = {fire=50, water=50, nature=200, neutral=100, ghost=100},
        water = {fire=200, water=50, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100},
        nature = {fire=50, water=200, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    }

    local m = 100
    if selement == 'physical' then
        if delement == 'ghost' then m = 0 end
    else
        local row = emult[selement]
        if row then
            m = row[delement] or 100
        end
    end

    local total_damage = 0
    local absorbed = 0
    local overkill = 0
    local crits = 0
    local resolved = 0
    local killed = false

    for k = 1, hits do
        if hp <= 0 then break end

        local p = math.max(10, power - 20*(k-1))
        local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)

        local diff = level - dlevel
        if diff < -10 then diff = -10 elseif diff > 10 then diff = 10 end
        d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3*diff) / 100)

        local is_crit = false
        local roll = (seed + 17*k) % 100
        if roll < crit_chance then
            is_crit = true
            d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
        end

        if not true_damage then
            local pen = pen_pct
            if is_crit then pen = pen * 2 end
            if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
            local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
            if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
            d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
        end

        local immune = false
        if not true_damage then
            d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
            if m == 0 then immune = true end
            local r = resist[selement] or 0
            if r < -50 then r = -50 elseif r > 80 then r = 80 end
            d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
        end

        if guarding then
            d = math.floor(d / 2)
        end

        if not immune then
            if d < 1 then d = 1 end
        end

        local a = math.min(shield, d)
        shield = shield - a
        local loss = d - a
        if a > 0 and shield == 0 then
            loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100)
        end

        if loss >= hp then
            overkill = loss - hp
            hp = 0
            killed = true
        else
            hp = hp - loss
        end

        absorbed = absorbed + a
        total_damage = total_damage + loss
        if is_crit then crits = crits + 1 end
        resolved = resolved + 1

        if hp <= 0 then break end
    end

    return {
        damage = total_damage,
        absorbed = absorbed,
        hp = hp,
        shield = shield,
        overkill = overkill,
        crits = crits,
        hits = resolved,
        killed = killed,
    }
end

local a1 = {atk=40, level=12, crit_chance=30, crit_mult=150, pen_pct=25, pen_flat=5}
local d1 = {hp=60, shield=10, armor=40, level=10, element='nature', resist={fire=20}, guarding=false}
local s1 = {power=120, element='fire', hits=2, true_damage=false, seed=3}
local r1 = resolve_attack(a1, d1, s1)

local a2 = {atk=90, level=3, crit_chance=50, crit_mult=200, pen_pct=40, pen_flat=10}
local d2 = {hp=300, shield=25, armor=60, level=20, element='fire', resist={water=-30}, guarding=true}
local s2 = {power=100, element='water', hits=3, true_damage=false, seed=40}
local r2 = resolve_attack(a2, d2, s2)

logic_define('resolve_attack', resolve_attack)

return string.format('Ex1: damage=%d absorbed=%d hp=%d shield=%d overkill=%d crits=%d hits=%d killed=%s | Ex2: damage=%d absorbed=%d hp=%d shield=%d overkill=%d crits=%d hits=%d killed=%s',
    r1.damage, r1.absorbed, r1.hp, r1.shield, r1.overkill, r1.crits, r1.hits, tostring(r1.killed),
    r2.damage, r2.absorbed, r2.hp, r2.shield, r2.overkill, r2.crits, r2.hits, tostring(r2.killed))
"}

  if n <= 0 then return 0 end
  if n == 1 then return 1 end
  if n == 2 then return 1 end
